┌ bzz ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                                              │
│  Welcome to bzz · Buzz in your terminal                                      │
│  Your team's chat, threads, huddles and agents, from the keyboard.           │
│                                                                              │
│  There is no community on this machine yet. Start with one of these:         │
│                                                                              │
│   d  Try the demo       a generated team, offline; nothing is saved          │
│ › j  Join a community   a new identity, then the community's address         │
│   p  Pair with Buzz     use the account of Buzz desktop on this machine      │
│   k  Import a key       a Buzz key or a backup file you already have         │
│                                                                              │
│  Join a community: run                                                       │
│    bzz identity new --label me                                               │
│    bzz community add my-team wss://<community address> <identity id>         │
│  The first prints your identity id and its pubkey. Give the pubkey           │
│  to the community's admin, and once you are added, start bzz again.          │
│                                                                              │
│  Enter choose · ↑↓ move · Esc back · ? keys · q quit                         │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
└ bzz ###### ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
